verdict.rationale: Passkey sync is a fair question for a password manager like 2FAS Pass, so the axis applies, but no evidence item mentions passkeys at all. The documented sync covers 2FAS Pass vault items and Auth tokens via iCloud, Google Drive or WebDAV, and covers iOS, Android and browser extensions only. Neither passkey storage nor syncing passkeys across platforms such as Windows or Linux is evidenced, and general vault sync cannot be credited as passkey sync.

support.subject: As a power user, my passkeys sync across ecosystems — iOS, Android, Windows, Linux, browsers — instead of being locked to one platform vendor
